text: In a low voice, in answer to Mr. Philips’ questions, he denied having ordered anything from Parkson’s in June. In fact, on June 29th, he had been staying away, in Wales. Instantly, Sir Ernest’s chin was shooting pugnaciously forward. “You deny having ordered a black beard from Parkson’s on June 29th?” “I do.” “Ah! In the event of anything happening to your brother, who will inherit Styles Court?” The brutality of the question called a flush to Lawrence’s pale face.
